name: Crispy Ground Chicken & Cheese Taquitos with Sour Cream

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 400°F. Coat a large baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil.
Place chicken, cheese, and spices in a medium bowl; mix with your hands until well combined.
instructions.secondary_message:
454 g ground chicken
1 cup cheddar cheese, shredded
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp garlic powder
½ tsp chili powder

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat. Once the skillet is hot, working in batches, add tortillas and cook, flipping once, until softened, 2-3 minutes. Remove to a flat surface.

Divide the chicken mixture between softened tortillas. Tightly roll tortillas to close, then arrange taquitos, seam-side down, on the baking sheet. Space them about 1-inch apart so they cook evenly, then drizzle with oil.
Place baking sheet in the oven and bake, turning taquitos halfway through, until golden on the edges and chicken is cooked through, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven.
Cut taquitos in half and divide between plates. Serve with sour cream for dipping and enjoy!
